facts.fact: Libya Post launched its postal addressing project at the start of 2025, installing address plates in a number of municipalities, with a first phase targeting numbering of 42,000 buildings and more than 23 municipalities to follow, as reported by the Libyan News Agency on 20 June 2025.

LBY.note: Nothing on authentication in the document.
No exchange of records between civil register and ID system is stated.
Commercial register is mentioned only in passing as a place where the address applies; nothing on its digital status.
No count or share of people holding a national ID is given.
No ID number at birth is mentioned.
Nothing on who runs the national ID system.
No public register is stated to be keyed on the national ID number.
Nothing on the national ID system's status.
Municipalities are addressing sites, not connected offices.
Nothing on digital civil registration at registry offices.
